summary: Kept. Singles $35-58 (FS table + rec.gov), doubles to $77, plus tax; 199 sites, 50A at ~half, water at ~10, sewer at two doubles; showers/flush/dump/store; season 2nd Fri March - 1st Sun Nov; rec.gov + FCFS, 14 max. WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview recommended (all 13 rec.gov 'Lakefront' sites are under continuous canopy; nearest F-loop pads 40-45 m from summer pool through forest, the rest 70-145 m).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE RECOMMENDED (rule: continuous canopy = view): stored lakefront -> lakeview. Cave Run Lake summer pool 730 ft = 222.5 m. rec.gov tags 13 sites 'Lakefront'. 3DEP ring search from each catalog point: F019 (38.093442,-83.522677, pad 230.1 m) pool at 40 m; F020 (38.093315,-83.523133, 227.9 m) 45 m; F022 (38.093075,-83.523255, 227.4 m) 40 m; F023 (38.092910,-83.523098, 227.2 m) 45 m - a gentle ~5 m slope, but Esri shows unbroken forest canopy from the loop road to the shoreline (tree crowns overhang the water). A030 (38.088326,-83.514214, 232.4 m) 70 m. D009/D011/D013 (38.0900,-83.5181 area, 236 m) 115-145 m. J008-J011, J014 (38.0990,-83.5160 area, 238 m) 95-130 m, deep canopy. So no site is within ~50 m over open ground, and the D and J 'Lakefront' tags are contradicted by their own catalog positions. Note for a human look: under the curation doc's canopy-blind clause the rec.gov flag at F019-F023 could be read as the primary source (gentle bank, 40-45 m); the brief's canopy rule makes it a view. Replacement evidence text: 'rec.gov Lakefront-tagged sites plotted on Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-23: F019-F023 40-45 m from summer pool (222.5 m) under continuous forest, A030 70 m, D009-D013 115-145 m, J008-J014 95-130 m -> lakeview'.
